ops.title: reviews_test: GraphQL fake sends data:null where GitHub sends partial data + errors
ops.description:
The reviewsServer fake (internal/cli/reviews_test.go:169-172) answers a not-found alias with `"data": null` plus an errors array. Real GitHub returns PARTIAL data — the alias key present and null — alongside the errors array.

Found 2026-08-01 while investigating a review finding that claimed a null alias decodes to a zero-value PR and silently watches PR 0. The finding was DECLINED with evidence: ghapi.GraphQL returns *GraphQLError whenever errors is non-empty, and errors.go unwraps a NOT_FOUND-typed message to ErrNotFound, so `ccx vcs reviews 99999` already exits 3 and never reaches the byNumber lookup. A production guard would have defended a state GitHub does not produce.

Also measured and worth keeping: encoding/json DOES set a map key whose value is null (storing the zero elem), so `pr, ok := byNumber[n]` reports ok==true — a presence check is the wrong shape for this; filtering on pr.Number == 0 in pullRequestsByNumber is the only one that works.

The residual is test fidelity only: if ghapi error handling ever stops mapping NOT_FOUND, the fake would not catch it because it never exercises the partial-data shape.

ops.text: Fake emits fields[name]=nil alongside the errors array, matching GitHub
TestReviewsNotFoundExitCode still passes for the right reason
